headline: Binance Records $3.64 Billion in Net Outflows Following Resumed Withdrawals
summary: Binance recorded $3.64 billion in net outflows after the resumption of withdrawals, representing 2.1% of its total $171 billion in assets under management.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and large fluctuations in its assets under management or sudden withdrawal spikes can signal liquidity stress or shifting user confidence across digital asset markets.

impacts.why: The platform experienced substantial net outflows totaling $3.64 billion.
